user.title: Hoymiles MS-G2
user.description: Discovered {count} device(s). Pick one from the list or type the device id manually. The device id has the form client_prefix-SN; only the serial (whose leading four digits are the product id) identifies the device, the prefix is yours to choose.

error.dev_id_invalid: The serial does not start with a four digit product id (e.g. 4161A0209FF6). The prefix in front of the dash can be anything.

charts.title: Optional device charts
charts.description: Tick a reading to add its curve card to this device's Device view. A card starts recording the moment it is ticked and only ever draws the data recorded after that, so an unticked-then-ticked card begins a fresh curve.

day_plan.title: Day plan
day_plan.description: Choose which day plan (day1..day8) to edit and how many time segments it has (max 12).

day_segment.title: Segment {index} of {total} ({day})
day_segment.description: mode 1=force charge, 2=PV charge, 4=discharge. ts/te are 15-minute slots (0-96), sh/sl are SOC in %, pc/pd are power limits in W.

week_plan.title: Week plan
week_plan.description: Map each weekday to one of the day plans. Choose 'none' to run self-consumption for that day.

get_plan.title: Get current plan
get_plan.description: Query the plan currently configured for one weekday. The result is shown in the status sensor and a notification.

set_mode.title: Set EMS mode
set_mode.description: general = device self-consumption, mqtt_ctrl = MQTT power control, tou_plan = time-of-use plan.

region.title: Region
region.description: The time zone this device's day is measured in. Today's yield resets at this zone's midnight and every displayed time follows it. Choose the first entry to follow Home Assistant, or type any IANA zone name such as Europe/Berlin.

abort.empty_week_plan: No weekday was mapped to a day plan, nothing was sent
abort.get_plan_failed: The device did not answer the plan query
abort.charts_unsupported: Optional charts are only available on a micro inverter (HiFlow / HiFlow Pro)
abort.charts_not_saved: The dashboard could not be written; no chart was changed

set_tou_day_plan.name: Set TOU day plan
set_tou_day_plan.description: Publish one TOU day plan (day1..day8) to the device.

set_tou_week_plan.name: Set TOU week plan
set_tou_week_plan.description: Publish the weekday to day-plan mapping.

get_tou_plan.name: Get TOU plan
get_tou_plan.description: Query the plan configured for one weekday.

set_ems_mode.name: Set EMS mode
set_ems_mode.description: Switch the EMS mode (general / mqtt_ctrl / tou_plan).

reboot.name: Reboot device
reboot.description: Send the RESTART command to the device.

set_phase_output_power.name: Set multi phase output power
set_phase_output_power.description: Set the output power limit of all three phases at once.

start_power_ctrl_keepalive.name: Start power control keep-alive
start_power_ctrl_keepalive.description: Re-publish one power_ctrl value on a period, because the firmware drops it after about a minute.

power.name: Power
power.description: Power limit in watt to hold.

stop_power_ctrl_keepalive.name: Stop power control keep-alive
stop_power_ctrl_keepalive.description: Stop re-publishing power_ctrl for a device.

get_optional_charts.name: Get optional device charts
get_optional_charts.description: Return which opt-in Device-view curves are enabled, and when each of them started recording.

set_optional_charts.name: Set optional device charts
set_optional_charts.description: Enable or disable the opt-in Device-view curves. A key that is left out is disabled, so send the complete set.

charts.name: Charts
charts.description: Object of chart key to boolean: grid_current, grid_frequency, active_power, reactive_power, rssi.
